Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: omitted cache.enabled now defaults to true for the Anthropic and Bedrock providers. The raw summary confirms that AICacheSettings.Enabled became *bool, that IsEnabled() was added, and that both providers now use it. The title is specific and matches the changeset and the linked objectives.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#3635` requirements, checked against head 1bed9d6: - Omitted vs. explicit `enabled` (`#3635`): `AICacheSettings.Enabled` is now `*bool`, and `IsEnabled()` in `pkg/schema/ai.go` returns true for a nil receiver or nil value. Only explicit `false` returns false. - Anthropic defaulting (`#3635`): `extractCacheConfig` in `pkg/ai/agent/anthropic/client.go` starts with caching enabled. A present block calls `applyCacheSettings`, which uses `settings.IsEnabled()`. Explicit `false` clears `enabled`, `cacheSystemPrompt` and `cacheProjectInstructions`, and returns early. - Bedrock defaulting (`#3635`): `extractCacheConfig` in `pkg/ai/agent/bedrock/cache.go` uses `settings.IsEnabled()`. Explicit `false` returns an empty config. Omitted or true with no fine-grained flags returns the defaults. Omitted or true with fine-grained flags keeps the selected flags. - Absent cache block (`#3635` acceptance): both providers return the default enabled config when `providerConfig.Cache == nil`. - Explicit `false` regardless of block selection (`#3635` acceptance): both providers disable caching when `enabled: false`, whatever the fine-grained flags are. - Selective caching (`#3635` acceptance): when enabled is omitted or true, Anthropic and Bedrock keep the selected system-prompt and project-instruction flags. If neither flag is set, both default to true. The two providers match. - Tests (`#3635`): the summary lists provider cases for an omitted `enabled` block, a config-decoding case for nil `Enabled`, and an `IsEnabled()` unit test. Existing cases use `*bool`. - Docs (`#3635`): `website/docs/cli/configuration/ai/providers.mdx` documents the omitted-`enabled` behavior. Residual uncertainty: I did not search the repository for other readers of the `Enabled` field. The raw summary lists no other changed consumers, so a missed consumer would show as a build failure, not a behavior gap. The bedrock and anthropic test files were not inspected line by line.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed files map to `#3635` objectives: - `pkg/schema/ai.go`: `*bool` field and `IsEnabled()` (shared presence-aware config). - `pkg/ai/agent/anthropic/client.go`: `applyCacheSettings` uses `IsEnabled()`. Cache-selection logic is otherwise unchanged. - `pkg/ai/agent/bedrock/cache.go`: `extractCacheConfig` uses `IsEnabled()`. Defaults and fine-grained behavior are unchanged. - Test files (`client_test.go`, `cache_test.go`, `ai_cache_config_test.go`, `ai_cache_test.go`): pointer-type updates and new cases for omitted `enabled`. These support the objectives. - `providers.mdx`: documents omitted-`enabled` behavior, as `#3635` requires. No unrelated change appears in the summary. System-prompt and project-instruction selection logic is unchanged, as the PR description states.
